T-014.title: Audit APIR server dependencies against endpoint-only message architecture
T-014.description: Use the pinned APIR artifact as comparative prior art only. Identify its server/database/snapshot/predicate/point-query dependencies and the properties they provide; compare those assumptions with the self-contained endpoint message requirement. Do not design or compose a server/database subsystem.
T-014.next_action: Complete 2026-11-18. The pinned APIR predicate path returns an authenticated scalar aggregate over a server-held database; the separate point-PIR path requires an index already known to the client.
